name: Floor Sweep
author: Tutez
description: Frees memory at the start of each floor, so the game no longer pauses for it mid-fight.
longDescription:
The game regularly pauses to free memory, sometimes for a tenth of a second or more, potentially in the middle of a fight. This mod does the biggest of these cleanups when a floor or the town is entered, during the transition's black screen, where it no longer gets in the way.

Short, more frequent cleanups still happen during a floor. Like the biggest ones, they get longer the longer the game runs: restarting it from time to time keeps them short.
